8.7.7.1. iLock_Geography.geo_algorithms.pathiter.SwitchIter.__init__¶

SwitchIter.__init__(path, diverging=None, facing=None)¶

Constructor.

Parameters:
  • path (IPath) – The path from which switch objects are iterated.
  • diverging (bool | none) – If True, only the switches with bent legs being traversed by path are iterated. If False, only the switches with straight legs being traversed by path are iterated. An argument of None is interpreted as “no restriction”.
  • facing (bool | none) – If True, only the facing switches in c{path} are iterated. If False, only the trailing switches are iterated. An argument of None is interpreted as “no restriction”.
Return type:

none
